customManagers.description: Images pinned inline under infrastructure/ -- CronJob pod specs and the ARC dind pod templates embedded in HelmRelease spec.values. Neither is reachable by a built-in manager: the `kubernetes` manager above is scoped to the db-migrations Jobs, the `flux` manager only reads chart versions, and `helm-values` only reads values.yaml FILES, not values inlined in a HelmRelease CR. Without this block every `# renovate:` comment under infrastructure/ is inert -- which is how the talos-backup pin in etcd-backup/cronjob.yaml has been carrying an annotation nobody was reading. Keyed on the annotation, so a file is scanned only where the comment is present and adding one is opt-in.

packageRules.description: db-migrations images tag as <component>-vX.Y.Z (release-please); teach Renovate that non-semver scheme so it can bump them

The two ARC runner images must move together with the chart pair, and a bad runner pin breaks CI invisibly -- a scale set idling at zero has no pod to crash, so the failure surfaces only when someone opens a PR. Group them into one reviewable bump.
